speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with aggressive behavior, altered mental status, and autonomic dysregulation. To begin our assessment, can you tell me exactly what symptoms you are feeling right now and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior.
